398- 399:

It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to the website of Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences (MAIDS) Reminiscing the stupendous past, one can unequivocally owe the accomplishments of the Institute to the persistent and continuous endeavours hallmarking the excellence and eminence of MAIDS in education, patient care and research. The glorious rise of the Institute to its present state symbolizes 36 years of commitment and is undoubtedly the manifestation of the spirit and strength of the “Team”, standing united in times of triumph and decline. The distinction earned over the years by the Institute is that of pure “endurance and determination”, to rise with might and overcome all hurdles. With an extremely humble start, growing in our own exemplary ways, we have all witnessed a monumental growth to the current “state of – the – art” establishment. This paradigm jump has not been an overnight task. The voyage has been interlaced with as many stumbling blocks as with moments of prosperity. Each trough and peak during this sojourn has created a memoir, which when revisited unveils “the unique experience”. Over the years MAIDS has been able to carve out a niche in dentistry that supports the idea of “unified spirit” and “relentless will” to achieve.

Our efficient team works relentlessly thus making them competent and skilled professionals and proficient team players in healthcare arena.
